relationships.description: Absent when the author declared none; the frontmatter schemas do not require the key, and the model must not require what the schema does not (FR-011-AC-15).

body.description: free text: the whole authored body; the archetype declares no `body_extraction`, because nothing authors one today.

description:
Finding document (archetype `Finding`), a child of `Review`. Deliberately a
different id namespace from the `FND-` rows inside a SpecReview: the document
and the row are different things, and one prefix would read as unification.
